queries.item: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ?:ab__sfb_authors ( author_id bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, status char(1) DEFAULT 'A', is_noindex char(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'N', canonical_id int(11) DEFAULT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (author_id) ) DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ?:ab__sfb_author_descriptions ( author_id bigint(20) NOT NULL, lang_code char(2) NOT NULL, name varchar(100) NOT NULL, short_description varchar(255) NOT NULL, full_description TEXT NOT NULL, author_rank varchar(50) NOT NULL, appointment varchar(50) NOT NULL, author_url varchar(255) NOT NULL, title varchar(255) NOT NULL, meta_description varchar(255) NOT NULL, meta_keywords varchar(255) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (author_id,lang_code) ) DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8
